newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: CAF lends $50mln to Placer's Las Cristinas.
newsitem.headline: CAF lends $50mln to Placer's Las Cristinas.

text.p: The Andean Development Corp (CAF), the financial arm of the Andean Community, said on Thursday that it had approved a $50 million loan for the Placer Dome-led Las Cristinas gold project in Venezuela.

The loan to the joint venture company Mineria Las Cristinas (MINCA), which is 70 percent owned by Placer and 30 percent by the Venezuelan government, will go towards estimated investment costs of $576 million for the project.
Placer has said the mine will produce an average of 450,000 ounces of gold per year for at least 16 years.
